mapper.select: SELECT NVL(t.total_amount, 0) AS total_amount FROM (SELECT LEVEL AS month_num FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 12) months LEFT JOIN ( SELECT TO_CHAR(so.in_date, 'MM') AS month, SUM(si.sales_item_cnt * si.sales_item_cost) AS total_amount FROM sales_order so LEFT JOIN sales_item si ON so.sales_no = si.sales_no WHERE TO_CHAR(so.in_date, 'YYYY') = #{value} GROUP BY TO_CHAR(so.in_date, 'MM') ) t ON TO_CHAR(months.month_num, 'FM00') = t.month ORDER BY months.month_num
